formal_definition: G_rec = Gamma(X_rec, O_rec, K_rec; Lambda_rec, T_rec)

dimensional_type_system.level: COMPONENT, never block. Broad blocks are organizational only and three of the eight are dimensionally heterogeneous.
dimensional_type_system.note: a coordinate is NOT declared dimensionless merely because its values are numerically standardized later

temporal_type_system.C0: inherit the primitive's temporal metadata unchanged
temporal_type_system.C1: inherit the source primitive's temporal-resolution qualification PLUS DERIVED_FROM_NUMERICAL_REALIZATION
temporal_type_system.C2: limited by the COARSER provenance-supported temporal resolution of the two operands, within each discharge
temporal_type_system.C3: limited by the COARSER provenance-supported temporal resolution of the two operands, within each discharge
temporal_type_system.C4: limited by the COARSER derivative-source resolution of numerator and denominator
temporal_type_system.invariant: no constructed coordinate may claim temporal information finer than either operand

flag_propagation.ALIASING_RISK: propagates from any operand to the output; levels remain primary admissible; no high-frequency physical claim may be made
flag_propagation.UPSTREAM_UPSAMPLED: level remains primary admissible; the first derivative is NUMERICAL_SENSITIVITY_ONLY and leaves the primary grammar
flag_propagation.precedence: where both flags occur, NUMERICAL_SENSITIVITY_ONLY dominates PRIMARY eligibility
flag_propagation.UNCALIBRATED_SIGNAL: level primary admissible; ALL derived constructors excluded from the primary ontology

provenance_propagation.invariant: if any primitive ancestor is target-forbidden, the coordinate is forbidden
provenance_propagation.holds_automatically_because: G_rec is generated from the already target-independent 78-primitive boundary; the invariant is encoded regardless

uncalibrated_signal_policy.rationale: their physical dimensions are unresolved, so the dimensional type of any constructed coordinate cannot be scientifically certified. This is a fail-closed dimensional-admissibility decision, NOT a claim that the signals carry no information.

constraints.evidence: S7.1 units registry: pinj is 'Total injected neutral beam power'; the per-beamline channels are its components. Confirmed by additivity in canonical units (S7.1R: per-beam W vs aggregate kW).
constraints.rule: a candidate representation containing the aggregate level AND all eight component levels is marked EXACT_LINEAR_REDUNDANCY_RISK
constraints.scope: REPRESENTATION_LEVEL, not coordinate level - at depth 1 with arity <= 2 no single coordinate can carry the whole exact set, so the redundancy can only appear in a coordinate SET
constraints.principle: deterministic restatements are not counted as independent scientific evidence

exact_dependency_constraints.invariant: neither aggregate nor components are removed at S7.5

numerical_realization.rule: second-order finite difference with respect to actual physical time t in seconds

capability_check.rule: second-order finite difference with respect to physical time t
capability_check.nonuniform_note: np.gradient accepts a non-uniform t vector but is only first-order there. Not relied upon: each T_s is UNIFORM within its own discharge; only dt differs BETWEEN discharges, which is the second-order case tested above.

numerical_realization.alternative_realizations: spline / RTS / other smooth realizations belong to S7.11 sensitivity qualification, not to the primary ontology
numerical_realization.interpretation: a derivative-valued coordinate is a constructor acting through a DECLARED numerical realization of a sampled trajectory; it is not evidence that the samples possess an exact classical derivative

primary_template.form: y_s(t) = beta_{0,s} + sum_{j=1..m} beta_{j,s} c_j(x_s)(t) + epsilon_s(t)

coefficient_dimensionality.consequence: every affine term beta_j c_j carries the target dimension m^-3, so coordinates within one relation need NOT share physical units; the fitted coefficients carry the compensating dimensions

estimator.note: the relation FAMILY is frozen here; the numerical ESTIMATOR is not. OLS vs ridge and any hyperparameter belong to the later frozen search policy. No estimator was run in S7.5.

coordinate_signature_schema.purpose: stable machine identity and duplicate prevention for coordinate instances that S7.6 will create

canonicalization.C2: PROD(i,j) with i = min(idx), j = max(idx) by frozen FINAL_SIGNAL_INVENTORY index
canonicalization.C4: PHASE(i|j) meaning D_{x_j} x_i, directional, i != j

duplicate_prevention.product_symmetry: PROD canonical ordering makes PROD(i,j) and PROD(j,i) the same identity
duplicate_prevention.self_ratio: RATIO(i,i) is not a valid signature
duplicate_prevention.self_phase: PHASE(i|i) is not a valid signature

symbolic_upper_bounds.note: symbolic upper bounds for audit. NO coordinate instance is enumerated here; instantiation belongs to S7.6.

raw_comparator_nested_in_ontology.statement: a representation whose coordinates are all C0 primitive levels is an admissible special case of G_rec
raw_comparator_nested_in_ontology.consequence: the raw-coordinate baseline B2 is nested inside the SIR ontology rather than being an external alternative

check_4_1_heterogeneous_blocks.action: record erratum 'four' -> 'three'; do NOT reopen S7.4

check_4_2_cadence_denominator.action: correct prose wording to 'one fewer than the number of source samples over the recorded support'; frozen computation unchanged
